title: bug: accounts CLI reports a missing claude as 'unknown', not MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND, when PATH holds an unsearchable dir
description: claudeAuth.ts runClaude sets notFound only on ENOENT. libuv's execvp returns EACCES when any PATH dir is unsearchable (here /root/.local/bin, mode 700). Repro on WSL: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/accounts/cli.test.ts` fails 'says when claude cannot be found…' with stderr ''. It passes once that entry is removed from PATH. Fix: on POSIX also treat EACCES as not found when the bin is a bare name, or resolve it on PATH first as the win32 path does.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST, in a NEW file: packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/claudeAuth.test.ts.
Why a new file: governor-693b7073's pending merge of main rewrites cli.test.ts's 'says when claude cannot be found' test to use an absolute missing path. That makes it deterministic, but it no longer reproduces this bug. A separate file is the regression and never overlaps the merge, so this task needs no merge gate. Don't touch cli.test.ts.

Setup:
- Wrap the cases in `describe.runIf(process.platform === 'linux' && process.getuid?.() !== 0)`. These are POSIX execvp semantics, verified on Linux, and root bypasses directory permissions.
- In beforeEach, create a mkdtemp dir. Inside it make `locked` (mkdirSync, then chmodSync 0o000) and an empty dir.
- In afterEach, chmod `locked` back to 0o700 BEFORE rmSync, so cleanup still works after a failed assertion.
- Every case passes an explicit env object. Never spread process.env: the seat's PATH, MOE_* and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR would leak in.
- Precondition, the first assertion of each EACCES case: `spawnSync('moe-no-such-claude-binary', [], { env: { PATH: locked } }).error?.code` equals 'EACCES'. This proves the case really takes the EACCES branch and cannot pass through ENOENT.

Cases:
1. Bare name behind an unsearchable dir:
   - `runClaude(claudeCommand({ MOE_CLAUDE_BIN: 'moe-no-such-claude-binary' }, 'linux'), ['auth', 'status', '--json'], { PATH: locked }, false)` toEqual `{ status: null, stdout: '', notFound: true }`.
   - `probeSignIn(<same command>, { PATH: locked })` toEqual `{ state: 'unknown', notFound: true }`.
   - With PATH `<empty>:<locked>` it is still not found.
2. Explicit path that exists but cannot run: a 0o644 file `<dir>/claude-no-exec`, run as `{ file: <it>, prefix: [], shell: false, missing: false }`. Expect notFound false and status null. This is deliberately unchanged: the task scopes the fix to bare names, and a present-but-unrunnable path is a different fault.
3. Control: PATH = the empty dir (ENOENT) still gives notFound true.
4. End to end, the reported symptom. Use io collecting out/err lines like cli.test.ts's cli() helper, with env `{ MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE: <dir>/claude-accounts.json, MOE_CLAUDE_BIN: 'moe-no-such-claude-binary', PATH: locked }`.
   - `runAccountsCli(['add'], io)` returns 0.
   - `runAccountsCli(['check'], io)` returns 1, and err contains `MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND: could not run "moe-no-such-claude-binary"`.
   - `readRegistry(<file>)` still shows acct-1's signInCheckedAt as null.
   - `runAccountsCli(['login', 'acct-1'], io)`'s err contains MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND.
   - accountConfigDir derives from the registry file, so the account folder stays in the temp dir.

Red proof: in step 3's snapshot, before step 2, cases 1 and 4 must fail (notFound false: 'unknown', with no MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND line) and cases 2 and 3 must pass. Quote it.
Report the new file in complete_step.newFiles/modifiedFiles.
implementationPlan.note: New claudeAuth.test.ts. Red proof in Linux snapshot at HEAD: 2 failed (bare name behind unsearchable dir; CLI MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND) | 2 passed (explicit non-exec path; ENOENT control). Dirty paths of other sessions untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
FIX packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/claudeAuth.ts, in runClaude's return value:
  notFound: errorCode === 'ENOENT' || (errorCode === 'EACCES' && path.basename(command.file) === command.file),

`path` is already imported. The bare-name test is enough on every platform:
- On win32 a bare name never reaches spawn: claudeCommand resolves it first, or returns missing.
- A resolved win32 file is a full path.
- The .js fake runs as process.execPath, an absolute path.

Add a two-line comment above it saying why: POSIX execvp keeps searching past an unsearchable PATH directory, or past a claude without the execute bit, then fails EACCES instead of ENOENT. For a PATH lookup that still means no runnable claude. An explicit path that exists but cannot run stays 'unknown'.

Error handling is otherwise unchanged:
- status stays null on any spawn error.
- signInStateOf still answers 'unknown' when notFound.
- cli.ts's notFoundMessage ("could not run \"<bin>\". Install Claude Code ... put it on PATH") already fits this case.

No other file changes. Report claudeAuth.ts in complete_step.modifiedFiles.
implementationPlan.note: notFound now also true for EACCES on a bare-name command.file, plus 2-line comment.

- The second run is the full daemon suite under env -i. At planning, on HEAD: 187 files, 5250 passed, 16 skipped.
- Then the package tsc and the new file's type check; both must exit 0.
If a file outside src/accounts fails, rerun without the cp overlay. Failing on pure HEAD too means it is pre-existing: quote both runs. Grep summaries with `grep -a`, since vitest logs can hold NUL bytes. Quote the summaries and GATE_EXIT in complete_task.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: When claude is looked up by bare name on PATH and the spawn fails EACCES (an unsearchable PATH directory, or a claude without the execute bit), runClaude reports notFound. So the accounts CLI prints MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND instead of reading the account as 'unknown'. ENOENT, explicit paths and the win32 resolution behave as before.
acceptanceCriteria: runClaude with a bare missing name and PATH = a mode-000 dir returns { status: null, stdout: '', notFound: true }, after a precondition proves the raw spawn errno is EACCES.
accounts check/login in that environment print MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND, and signInCheckedAt stays null.
An explicit non-executable path still yields notFound false (scope pinned).
Mutants (ENOENT-only; every EACCES) each turn a case red.
The snapshot gate exits 0, including src/accounts with the seat PATH that contains /root/.local/bin.
invariants: The win32 path (findWindowsCommand, missing) is unchanged.
status is null on any spawn error.
compatibility: No stored state or wire change; only the CLI's message for this environment changes from 'unknown' to MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND.
approvedScope: claudeAuth.ts runClaude: the notFound expression plus a comment.
reuse: claudeCommand, runClaude, probeSignIn, runAccountsCli, readRegistry; the io-collecting pattern of cli.test.ts's cli() helper.

packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts prints notFoundMessage when probeSignIn or runClaude reports notFound.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Resolve claude on PATH first on POSIX, as win32 does. Rejected: it is a new resolver and changes how claude is spawned (absolute path, skipping empty PATH entries), all to fix one errno mapping. The bare-name EACCES mapping is one expression. (2) Treat every EACCES as not found. Rejected: the task scopes the fix to bare names, and an explicit path that exists but cannot run is a different fault (case 2 pins this). (3) Change cli.test.ts's existing not-found test. Rejected: main's commit, arriving with governor-693b7073's pending merge, already rewrites it to use an absolute missing path, which no longer exercises the bug. Editing it would collide with the merge.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- claudeAuth.runClaude maps only ENOENT to notFound.
- claudeCommand returns the bare `claude` (or MOE_CLAUDE_BIN) on POSIX. On win32 it resolves PATH x PATHEXT first and returns missing when nothing matches.
- Measured with libuv in WSL as uid 1000:
  - a mode-000 dir on PATH, before or after an empty dir, gives EACCES;
  - an empty dir gives ENOENT;
  - a non-executable file gives EACCES, found on PATH or given by path.
- The seat PATH here contains /root/.local/bin (mode 700), which is why the original failure appears. Repro at HEAD in a Linux snapshot: cli.test.ts fails 1/14 with the seat PATH and passes with a clean one.
- cli.ts notFoundMessage: 'MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND: could not run "<bin>". Install Claude Code where this terminal runs (and put it on PATH), then try again.'
- accountConfigDir derives from the registry file path, so a temp MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE keeps account folders in the temp dir.
- 3f6817f1 touches only cli.test.ts in src/accounts (6+/2-).
planningNotes.risks:
- The daemon tests cannot run from the shared tree under WSL, because node_modules is Windows-native. Use step 3's snapshot.
- A root runner bypasses permissions, which is why the cases runIf non-root.
- macOS libuv semantics are unverified, which is why they runIf Linux. CI runs daemon tests on ubuntu only.
- Leaving `locked` at mode 0o000 breaks tmp cleanup, so restore it before rmSync.
